text:
sam.ortega: Heads-upI'll be on a short notice work trip to Vancouver from 2026-09-10 -> 2026-11-01 to help with a partner integration. I'm a US citizen, paid in USD on US payroll, no Canadian invoices. Do we need to run Canadian payroll or withhold CRA deductions? cc @jamie.payroll

jamie.payroll: Thanks for flagging. Short answer: possibly. Canada has different rules by province and the US-Canada totalization agreement can help with CPP/EI, but we need to confirm whether this is a formal secondment or just travel. Also check whether you'll cross 183 days and whether you'll do any contracting locally.

anita.tax: Follow-ups: 1) Will Redwood issue a local PO/invoice or sign anything with the Canadian partner? 2) Are you getting reimbursed for housing/per-diem? 3) Will you be supervised locally or reporting to the Vancouver office? If you're formally seconded and remain on US payroll, a Certificate of Coverage can exempt you from Canadian CPP/EI. If not, employer withholding and CRA registration might be required.

leah.legal: Please hold on any partner contracts that list you as the local representative until we confirm. We also need manager sign-off on the travel and an internal secondment memo. Potential PE risk is low for short technical work but we should document scope.

jamie.payroll: Action checklist for Sam (paste back once complete):
```
- travel dates: 2026-09-10 -> 2026-11-01
- country/province: Canada / British Columbia (Vancouver)
- home country: USA
- employer on payroll: Redwood Inference (stay on US payroll?) yes/no
- manager approval: attach
- client-facing/local contracting: yes/no (describe)
- reimbursements: housing/per-diem? yes/no
- benefits: remain on US benefits? yes/no
```

sam.ortega: Filling in now 1) employer stays US payroll, 2) manager approved (attached), 3) no local contracts signed, 4) reimbursed for hotel only, no per-diem, 5) staying on US benefits.

anita.tax: Good. Next steps: we'll request a Certificate of Coverage (US social security) if you remain on US payroll. That process takes 2-4 weeks. If certificate can't be obtained, payroll vendor may need to register with CRA and run local net payroll (source deductions) which is slower and could require a Canadian bank account for net pay. Also, provincial health coverage rules are separate; advise you to check BC MSP enrollment rules for temporary residents.

leah.legal: I'll prepare a secondment memo and signature page. Also flagging data residency/questions if you'll be handling partner data in Canada.

payroll-bot: Logged case INT-2521. Assigned: jamie.payroll. Vendor outreach ETA: 48 hours.

jamie.payroll: I'll open the HR portal short-assignment form now and loop in our global payroll vendor. Expect an email asking for passport, travel itinerary, and manager approval. We'll confirm by EOD whether vendor thinks local registration is required.

sam.ortega: Thanks all 44d Appreciate the quick turnaround.
